changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.rollback: create or alter procedure [bulkload].[UpdateFusionConfigurationColumn] @id int, @fusionConfigColumn int as begin set nocount on; update T set T.LookupObject = 'Fusion', T.LookupObjectID = S.ID from LoadItemColumn T inner join Fusion S on lower(S.Name) = lower(T.Value) and T.ColumnIndex = @fusionConfigColumn and T.LoadID = @id end
